items.title: Bias published in Science
items.text: Obermeyer et al. show a widely used care-management score under-refers Black patients.

items.title: Algorithmic Bias Playbook
items.text: Chicago Booth's four steps for organisations: inventory, screen, retrain or suspend, prevent.

items.title: First healthcare AIA
items.text: The Ada Lovelace Institute's NHS pilot puts patients into the assessment loop.

items.title: Swap-code erratum
items.text: A one-line bug fix raises the corrected counterfactual share of Black patients from 47% to 59%.

items.title: New York regulators write to UnitedHealth
items.text: DFS and DOH ask the company to show Impact Pro is not discriminatory or stop using it.

items.title: Senators Booker and Wyden demand answers
items.text: Letters to CMS, the FTC and five insurers ask what safeguards exist.

items.title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
items.text: Voluntary Govern–Map–Measure–Manage framework; 'fair, with harmful bias managed'.

items.title: ONC HTI-1 rule
items.text: Certified health-IT developers must disclose source attributes of predictive tools they supply.

items.title: Section 1557 rule (45 CFR 92.210)
items.text: Bans discrimination through patient-care decision-support tools; identify-and-mitigate duty keyed to tool inputs.

items.title: Colorado AI Act (SB 24-205)
items.text: First state law with deployer impact assessments. It never takes effect.

items.title: OCR guidance; EO 14110 revoked
items.text: OCR confirms §92.210 duties are input-based; EO 14148 revokes the federal AI order.

items.title: EO 14281
items.text: Agencies told to deprioritise disparate-impact enforcement.

items.title: EO 14365; HTI-5 proposed
items.text: Federal push against state AI laws; ONC proposes dropping algorithm source attributes.

items.title: Colorado SB 26-189
items.text: AI Act repealed and re-enacted as a notice regime without impact assessments.

items.title: HHS Title VI rule
items.text: HHS removes the disparate-impact ('effects') provisions from its Title VI regulations.

items.title: Colorado notice duties
items.text: Scheduled start; enforcement currently stayed in xAI v. Weiser.

items.title: SCHUFA judgment (C-634/21)
items.text: A score can itself be an automated decision under GDPR Art 22.

items.title: AI Act enters into force
items.text: Healthcare eligibility decided by public bodies is listed as high-risk (Annex III 5(a)).

items.title: Digital Omnibus (Reg. 2026/1744)
items.text: High-risk obligations delayed to Dec 2027; new Art 4a permits bias-detection data.

items.title: AI Act Annex III duties apply
items.text: Risk management, bias examination, FRIA and human oversight begin.

items.title: NITI Aayog Responsible AI
items.text: Seven voluntary principles, including equality and accountability.

items.title: ICMR AI guidelines
items.text: Ten principles for AI in healthcare, including validity and non-discrimination; voluntary.

items.title: DPDP Act enacted
items.text: India's first data-protection statute; duties wait for rules.

items.title: DPDP Rules notified; AI guidelines
items.text: Phased commencement over 18 months; MeitY opts for voluntary AI governance.

items.title: CDSCO medical-device software guidance
items.text: Bias and training-data evidence requested, but only for software that is a medical device.

items.title: DPDP main duties
items.text: Notice, security and Significant Data Fiduciary obligations begin.
